PerfNet-Microsoft-Windows-Process-General	Process counters from the Windows-Process provider.
Mellanox WinOF-2 Adapter Diagnostics	Diagnostic counters for the Mellanox WinOF-2 NIC driver.
Mellanox WinOF-2 Adapter QoS	QoS counters for the Mellanox WinOF-2 NIC driver.
Mellanox WinOF-2 RSS Per Processor	Per-CPU receive-side scaling counters surfaced by the Mellanox WinOF-2 driver.
Network Adapter	Counters for one network adapter.
Network Interface	Counters for one network interface.
Processor	Counters for one logical processor.
Processor Information	Extended counters for one logical processor.
Memory	Counters for system memory usage.
TCPv4	IPv4 TCP counters.
TCPv6	IPv6 TCP counters.
UDPv4	IPv4 UDP counters.
UDPv6	IPv6 UDP counters.
IPv4	IPv4 counters.
IPv6	IPv6 counters.
PhysicalDisk	Counters for one physical disk.
LogicalDisk	Counters for one logical disk.
System	System-wide counters.
Intel(R) Ethernet 10G 2P X710	Counters for the Intel X710 NIC.
Broadcom NetXtreme-E	Counters for the Broadcom NetXtreme-E NIC.
SomeVendorRandomSet	A counter set with no recognized vendor prefix.
